ansatz.depth_extension_rule: Prepare each label's reference once and apply complete shared-parameter layers ell=1,...,D_ans in increasing ell. Extend D_ans to D_ans+1 by appending one complete layer with fresh theta[D_ans+1,j], zeta[D_ans+1,j], and rho[D_ans+1,j]. The earlier gate sequence is an exact prefix. Setting every appended angle to 0 makes every appended gate exactly the identity.

layer_operations.angle: 2*theta[ell,j] in the Qiskit XXPlusYYGate angle convention

index_ranges.iteration_order: Within each layer apply all XXPlusYYGate instances first, sequentially in increasing j
index_ranges.parameter_sharing: theta[ell,j] is shared between the phi and psi circuit instances

index_ranges.iteration_order: After all XXPlusYYGate instances of layer ell, apply all RZZGate instances sequentially in increasing j
index_ranges.parameter_sharing: zeta[ell,j] is shared between the phi and psi circuit instances

index_ranges.iteration_order: After all RZZGate instances of layer ell, apply RZGate instances in increasing j
index_ranges.parameter_sharing: rho[ell,j] is shared between the phi and psi circuit instances

ansatz.parameter_order_rule: Use one shared parameter vector for phi and psi. Order layers by ell=1,...,D_ans. Within layer ell, first list theta[ell,j] for j=0,...,8 in increasing j, then zeta[ell,j] for j=0,...,8 in increasing j, then rho[ell,j] for j=0,...,9 in increasing j. Distinct indices and layers share no parameter. Each layer has 9 theta, 9 zeta, and 10 rho parameters, totaling 28 independent shared parameters.

physical_sector.rule: Both references have Hamming weight 5 and Q_lat=-(1/2)*sum_j Z_j=0. Every adjacent XXPlusYY gate mixes only |01> and |10> and commutes with n_j+n_(j+1); every RZZ and RZ gate is occupation diagonal. Therefore every intermediate gate, complete ordered layer, and repeated-layer circuit remains in the full 252-dimensional weight-5 sector. The authoritative reconstructed G_0,...,G_4 Pauli sums cancel identically on the full ten-qubit space, so the mapped Gauss constraints are also preserved exactly. Adjacent exchanges connect the complete weight-5 configuration graph, while RZZ and RZ phases provide non-Gaussian interacting phases.

ansatz.reference_state_rule: Use two mutually orthogonal weight-5 computational references. For phi initialize |0>^10 and apply X to q1, q3, q5, q7, q9. For psi initialize |0>^10 and apply X to q1, q3, q4, q7, q9. Apply the same parameterized unitary to both references, so their orthogonality is preserved exactly while they represent distinct requested levels.

phi.basis_state: 0101010101 in declared logical order q0=c[0,1], q1=c[0,2], q2=c[1,1], q3=c[1,2], q4=c[2,1], q5=c[2,2], q6=c[3,1], q7=c[3,2], q8=c[4,1], q9=c[4,2]; equivalently |1010101010> in Qiskit b9...b0 display order

psi.basis_state: 0101100101 in declared logical order q0=c[0,1], q1=c[0,2], q2=c[1,1], q3=c[1,2], q4=c[2,1], q5=c[2,2], q6=c[3,1], q7=c[3,2], q8=c[4,1], q9=c[4,2]; equivalently |1010011010> in Qiskit b9...b0 display order

symmetry_preservation.gate_level_reason: Under the authoritative electric-field reconstruction every expanded G_N is the zero operator after exact Pauli collection. Both references and every number-conserving layer therefore satisfy all five mapped Gauss constraints without gauge-link qubits or penalties.

The references have five occupations. XXPlusYY preserves pair occupation and RZZ and RZ are occupation diagonal, so every gate commutes with Q_lat. Adjacent exchanges connect all weight-5 basis configurations, so exact charge preservation does not obstruct access to either requested level.
No charge-conjugation eigenvalue is assigned. Generic local RZ and RZZ parameters need not commute with the particle-hole Clifford, so imposing C would add an unsupported restriction.
Fermionic reflection is an exact Hamiltonian symmetry but neither level has an assigned parity eigenvalue. The ordered open-chain layer is not constrained to commute with the FSWAP reflection.
T is antiunitary and has no assigned target eigenvalue. Generic exchange and phase angles do not enforce the required FSWAP component exchange followed by complex conjugation.
No PT eigenvalue is supplied, and the generic shared layer is not constrained to commute with the declared antiunitary composition.
The authoritative open-boundary Hamiltonian explicitly breaks the candidate cyclic spatial translation, so translation is not imposed on either reference or layer.

There is no finite-lattice continuous spatial-translation generator. Requiring the variational layer to commute with the time-translation generator H_qc would obstruct exploration from the references and is not a target-sector requirement.
The contract supplies no exact finite-lattice boost generator, so no boost constraint is placed on the circuit.
